QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year] Fireworks Light Up a Party!
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie's watching the fireworks, but he doesn't seem to be enjoying them. Ask him what's wrong.
QuestInfo.2:
Gold Richie bought a bunch of fireworks as gifts for all of the officers, but monsters stole them! 
You can't let them ruin all the fun!

#bFireworks monsters will spawn every 15 minutes in #m100000000#, #m240000000#, and #m450001000# during the event. Defeat them, and get those fireworks back!#k
